limitations.note: The starting author WikiRisotto body was overwritten;original URL/hash/bytes remain only as metadata. This review relies on fresh independent canonical Rizoto and culinary/media sources,does not reconstruct that body or claim its old bytes survive.
Publisher school page direct request failed;failure retained,no bypass,no false native-body claim. Soia has independent native crop/consumer proof and fresh dictionary evidence.

evidence_notes: All original eleven zero-input holds retain their reasons and author clocks;fresh recognition cannot rescue them.
Original foreign/archaic/other-sense hypotheses remain unadmitted;Jimblă rejected as archaic,unsupported Croissant/Risotto families held.
Qualified/diminutive inputs are not universal synonyms;only Jambon and food Cocă receive explicit exact-sense family acceptance.
Șuncă→Salată is independently verified by direct fresh ham-salad recipes;the original sandwich source alone supports lettuce/sandwich context and is not used here as dish proof.
The original Ghiveci→Legume edge is already related_to with a truthful prepared-from caption;no historical is_a correction is signed.
Tiramisu sources include variants,not alcohol-dependent game value;storage,clinical,animal-myth,foraging and unrelated claims were excluded.
This report judges source stock only. Game associations are prospective utility,not boards,groups,pairs,recipes,hidden targets,paths,difficulty or serving promotion.
